"Sugar Skull Cash" has joined the Texas lineup at $5 with four top prizes of $100,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything here about "Sugar Skull Cash" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through September 29.
2773.headline: New game, all prizes left
